notes: Candidate-only samples reauthenticate every real claim and plan in a previously seeded private registry; no current claims, tokens, or outputs are produced.
Current-plan validation, all candidate checks, close witnesses and handle release are included; setup and lock wait are reported separately.
Current plans are parsed during fixture preparation, as in the reconcile API benchmark; CLI plan parsing is outside these validation phase timings.
The fresh fixture was seeded once; repeated read sets do not imply a cold OS cache. Profiler and timer-only runs occurred separately on a workstation with variable timings.
As-run fingerprints retain Windows working-file bytes; Git-normalized fingerprints are recorded separately after verifying only CRLF-to-LF differences and identical ASTs for all four helpers.
Native calls are reported explicitly; cProfile's Python stat count alone is not total filesystem work. Full shadow registry_scans includes two native inventories plus the reference scan.
Initially case-sensitive directories and noncanonical positive spellings fall back; case-mode changes alone need not change NTFS USNs.
Independent observers' close markers can invalidate common ancestor versions and cause conservative reference fallback.
Unsupported capability, access, format, changed observations, resource limits, or unknown errors grant no indexed authority.
The NTFS object argument does not certify DOS-device mapping lifetime or an atomic snapshot against unsynchronized memory-mapped record writers.

Protocol v1, lock namespace, tokens, and recovery/publication formats are preserved. Dangling retained plan links and inaccessible record metadata now fail validation instead of being silently skipped.
